newsitem.title: USA: HMT files to register 10 mln shares at SEC.
newsitem.headline: HMT files to register 10 mln shares at SEC.

text.p: HMT Technology Corp filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to 10 million common shares, of which it will sell one million shares and a group of shareholders will sell nine million shares.
Underwriters for the offering are Salomon Brothers Inc, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Hambrechts & Quist and Robertson Stephens & Co.

Those selling shares include: Summit Partners LP, which will sell 5.2 million shares and reduce its stake in the company to 22.4 percent from 35.7 percent; and Hitachi Metals Ltd, which is reducing its stake to 8.3 percent from 12.5 percent by selling almost 3.5 million shares.
After the offering, HMT will have 42,296,187 shares outstanding. The company said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells for capital expenditures and other general corporate needs.
